snippet.title: VR Roguelike with Physical Head Movement | Hyperlane Highway Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
VR Roguelike endless runner where you physically lean your head to dodge, 
steer and fight through faster-than-light hyperlanes. No thumbstick movement needed.

Wishlist on Steam: 

Hyperlane Highway is a VR roguelike endless runner built solo over 2 years 
for SteamVR and Meta Quest. Deep card upgrade system, corporate sponsors, 
enemy waves and environments that get faster the better you play.

Coming to Steam Early Access and Meta Quest.

#HyperlaneHighway #VRGaming #IndieGame #VRRoguelike #MetaQuest
